description: One state and feedback vocabulary for every surface — empty (no-source / no-matches / deleted-relation), loading, error, success notice with an undo affordance, destructive confirm — reduced to shared primitives: one empty-state component absorbing chart's private vocabulary, one toast component with severity and an action slot, one confirm primitive carrying 044's sheet grammar and 048's stacking, one motion-token set with reduced-motion coverage. Implements 050 items 5, 8, 9 and 14 at their recorded thresholds.
